providers.name: WindowsDpapiProvider
providers.rule: CryptProtectData/CryptUnprotectData; no CRYPTPROTECT_LOCAL_MACHINE; CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN; purpose-bound optional entropy

providers.name: WindowsAclProvider
providers.rule: canonical owned security/runtime/diagnostic paths reject unsafe inheritance/reparse targets

providers.name: SqlCipherConnectionSecurityProvider
providers.rule: LLD-01 retains connection/UoW/repository authority but swaps stdlib sqlite3 provider for accepted SQLCipher-compatible DB-API implementation

providers.name: AuditWriter
providers.method: append required LLD-12 registered audit action inside caller UnitOfWork

providers.name: LocalUserProfileProvider
providers.method: get singleton local administrator actor/profile identity without credential fields

providers.name: DeliberateActionProofProvider
providers.owner: LLD-12 consumed by LLD-10 and owner commands
providers.rule: proof is single-use, session/run-bound, expires quickly and proves only deliberate interaction; owning command still revalidates business eligibility

cross_packet_rule: LLD-12 supplies security contexts/proofs/key access and never performs another domain's business mutation; consumers must not copy secrets into their own storage.
